AGRICULTURE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #15
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. watt (W)

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Preserving Crop Products? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Preserving Crop Products.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Preserving Crop Products.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Preserving Crop Products.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Preserving Crop Products.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food 13 3.0 Hygiene Practices 3.1 Good Grooming 9 3.2 Laundry: Stain Rem? (1 mark)

   A. Primary consumers only
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
